review.posthog_relevance: Adds command metadata and OAuth authentication support for PostHog's agent workflow and command tracking, while also documenting disambiguation behavior for shared display names.
review.reason: The chunk includes substantive implementation and permission changes: adding command metadata properties, establishing OAuth client access for the agent workflow, and documenting disambiguation behavior. While the chunk is dominated by documentation and tests, the implementation and permission changes are present and relevant to PostHog's agent and command tracking capabilities.
